signature: “M. IOHANN LEONHARD EHE. IN. NURN” [master’s mark: IL (Turk’s head with turban) E”]
remarks: Waterhouse 1993: 102 mentions a trombone in Stockholm by Friedrich Ehe, dated 1741—perhaps the remarks refer to this instrument; ferrules have plain ring pattern; 2 tubular slide stays, with typical Nuremberg-style floral pattern, moveable one telescopic; no ring or saddle in slide bow; dents and repair at slide bow; bell bow has saddle (with zigzag pattern) and ring; 1 flat bell stay with hinge and pin, no eye; typical Nuremberg-style floral pattern on bell stay; garland has raised dots (not shells); Nuremberg-style rim wire with leaf pattern; floral pattern on garland.
